title: The Shadow's End
description: The Shadow's End — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: GoTo / Kill

Quest Description: Find and kill the Shadowlord in the Crypt of the Shadow Lord, located off of Level 3 of Algernon. Afterward, return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 4 King's Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Find and kill the Shadowlord in the Crypt of the Shadow Lord, located off of Level 3 of Algernon. Afterward, return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

The undead scourge is being lead by the Shadow Lord, a foe I have met before, and he must be stopped. Go into the Shadow Lord's crypt, find his Throne Room, and kill him there. Banish his soul back to the Abyss!

Once you have vanquished the Shadow Lord return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

You've done this dark deed? Huzzah, Dungeon Runner, you have saved me from having to vanquish the Shadow Lord myself and I thank you! So does my ailing back!

Objectives:

  • Shadow Lord's Throne Room
  • Slay the Shadowlord

Level range: 8–20
